en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of camels and riders halted on a dirt road beside low stone buildings and cypress trees. Several men in light colonial-style clothing stand or sit on camels, while other camels are resting on the ground with loads. At the top left there is a small printed French caption. The lower part of the image is heavily covered with handwritten cursive text in French.
